metadata.title: Retro Progressive Rock Album Cover Style

retrievalProfile.description: Creates a 1970s-style collage featuring soft-focus airbrushed skin tones, intricate textile patterns like lace and crochet, and speed-line display typography.
triggerTerms: soft focus skin with lace textures

recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist-leaning collage composition dominated by a large, soft-focus airbrushed anatomical form, contrasted against intricate crochet patterns, white lace trim, and a hazy, impressionistic background of blue and green washes.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between smooth airbrushed skin and high-detail textile patterns
Diagonal division created by a white lace border
Hazy, atmospheric background framing a central warm-toned subject
Dynamic speed-line typography integrated into the upper quadrant
coreInvariants: Soft-focus airbrushed gradient on the primary subject
Presence of a white scalloped lace edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, close-up anatomical form occupies the center and lower-right, scaled to dominate the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The diagonal white lace trim acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal lace from the center-left down to the bottom-right, then moves up to the display text in the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper-right and top-left corners provide atmospheric negative space with hazy, mottled textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and peach tones for the central skin-like form.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool sky blue and moss green in the background washes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for the display typography and earth tones for the crochet pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with soft, diffused lighting and minimal harsh shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy, analog-film inspired hues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Italicized sans-serif with extended horizontal strokes
letterConstructionRules: Letters are composed of multiple parallel horizontal speed lines
Open counters and thick, uniform stroke weights
Red fill with white or light outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' features elongated top and middle bars that merge into the speed lines
Terminals are cut at sharp angles to emphasize motion

composition.relationshipToImage: layered on top of the hazy background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative display face paired with a small, clean sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the speed-line and italicized motion feel.
Necessary to replicate the specific parallel line construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed, soft-focus image featuring a large warm-toned skin surface, a diagonal white lace trim, a zig-zag patterned textile, and a hazy blue/green mottled background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom red italicized lettering with horizontal speed lines in the top-left corner, ensuring a thin white outline for legibility.

verificationChecks: Check for soft-focus airbrush texture on skin
Ensure the lace trim follows a clear diagonal path
Verify the typography uses parallel horizontal lines
Confirm the color palette is muted and retro

adjustableVariables: Angle of the diagonal lace divider
Number of speed lines in the typography
postGenerationChecks: Does the image look like a physical 1970s vinyl record cover?
Is the transition between the skin and the background soft and blended?
Are the speed lines in the text clearly defined and horizontal?
Is the lace texture detailed enough to be recognizable?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Airbrushed Subject] + [Diagonal Lace Border] + [Patterned Textile] + [Speed-Line Typography] in a [Muted 70s Palette].
